question: Regarding electric flux sign and orientation on a closed surface:

options.A: Flux is defined with respect to the outward normal; it can be negative if field lines enter the surface.
options.B: Flux is always non-negative because it counts field lines.
options.C: Flux uses an inward normal by convention.
options.D: Flux is a vector whose direction is that of the normal.
